verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents adding evidence files to a case's Files tab with in-app viewing, a case Comments section with @-mentions, and an automatic audit trail of all work. Case data including comments can be exported, so recorded evidence and notes stay part of a retrievable investigation history. Decision reasons are only implied by marketing that every decision stays defensible. Missing for 10: a documented field or workflow for recording disposition or decision rationale, explicit docs that notes and evidence appear in a chronological case history view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
